chat_bot_thread_sessions_owner_shape.name: chat_bot_thread_sessions_owner_shape
chat_bot_thread_sessions_owner_shape.value:
("chat_bot_thread_sessions"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_bot_thread_sessions"."anonymous_id" IS NULL AND "chat_bot_thread_sessions"."expires_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("chat_bot_thread_sessions"."user_id" IS NULL AND "chat_bot_thread_sessions"."anonymous_id" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_bot_thread_sessions"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

tenant_credit_ledger_sign.name: tenant_credit_ledger_sign
tenant_credit_ledger_sign.value: ("tenant_credit_ledger"."kind" = 'grant' and "tenant_credit_ledger"."amount_usd" >= 0) or ("tenant_credit_ledger"."kind" = 'topup' and "tenant_credit_ledger"."amount_usd" > 0) or ("tenant_credit_ledger"."kind" in ('scan_hold', 'expiry') and "tenant_credit_ledger"."amount_usd" < 0) or "tenant_credit_ledger"."kind" in ('scan_settle', 'adjustment')

scan_finding_triage_accepted.name: scan_finding_triage_accepted
scan_finding_triage_accepted.value: ("scan_finding_triage"."status" = 'accepted_risk') = ("scan_finding_triage"."accepted_until" is not null) and ("scan_finding_triage"."status" <> 'accepted_risk' or "scan_finding_triage"."note" is not null)

scan_findings_severity.name: scan_findings_severity
scan_findings_severity.value:
("scan_findings"."status" = 'confirmed' and "scan_findings"."severity" in ('critical', 'high', 'medium', 'low', 'informational'))
        or ("scan_findings"."status" = 'needs_validation' and "scan_findings"."severity" is null)
